paragraphs: PayByPhone sells a mobile app for paying for parking in a few taps, without coins or hunting for the machine. It is available in over 1,200 cities across North America and Europe, including universities and colleges.

A driver connects a credit or debit card to a PayByPhone account and pays from the phone. Where available, Google Pay or Apple Pay can complete the transaction instead. A session can be extended from the app, with no need to run back to the car to feed the meter.

The company dates its start to 2001 and a plan to take the pain out of parking. It now describes a mission spanning three continents. The home page puts all-time users at more than 125 million. Ownership sits with Lightyear Capital, a New York-based private equity firm with over US$8 billion in assets under management. The press page also announces a global partnership with SKIDATA covering parking and access control solutions. Jonny Combe is named as President and Chief Executive Officer.

quote.text: No coins, no hunting for the machine, just a clever little app
